title: Project Overview & Mission
description: InvestMant is a real-time investment and financial market tracking suite featuring live Forex Factory calendar integration, portfolio analytics, and multi-asset market intelligence.

title: Frontend Application Core
description: The React single-page frontend boots from main.tsx and App.tsx, orchestrating routing across Portfolio, Market Overview, Forex Calendar, and Research Terminal.

title: Market & Forex Factory Integration
description: Forex Factory economic news, market data views, and financial instrument tracking components provide real-time economic calendars and volatility alerts.

title: Backend Proxy & Server
description: Express server (server.ts) handles local proxying, Forex Factory XML calendar feeds, CORS bypassing, and API endpoints for portfolio persistence.

title: Android Mobile Wrapper
description: Capacitor enables Android APK packaging, bridging the web client into an offline-capable mobile Android application.
